test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Manoj is the husband of Sapna, whose mother is Neelam. Neelam's grandson is Aditya, who is the brother of Shefali.

Shefali is the daughter of Vijay who is the brother of Manoj's wife. How is Sapna related to Shefali?
solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e20f8e463dec121ef2127ecd0e3d8451f6c05cbd529fd1b01640f5ba2298ffef.png] 

(1) Manoj is the husband of Sapna, whose mother is Neelam.

(2) Shefali is the daughter of Vijay who is the brother of Manoj's wife. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7371e2854f066c50b45c0802be81317dd631991fbf959627bd606af0bdf12b35.png] 

(3) Neelam's grandson is Aditya, who is the brother of Shefali. Therefore, the final family tree is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ef2d2b44596568d33379742f5544f7d18738e837371fc07a0fbd227ad9c3631.png] 

Hence, Sapna is the paternal aunt of Shefali.
